units.source_text: 当时有些地方官之类的人，想在京中物色饶有风趣的邸宅，

en.t: At that time, certain people such as provincial officials were looking in the capital for a residence with charm,

units.source_text: 看中了这宫邸内的参天古木，便央人介绍，来问此邸宅肯否出卖。

en.t: and, taken with the towering old trees on the grounds of this princely mansion, they asked someone to introduce them and came to inquire whether the residence might be sold.

units.source_text: 侍女们听到了，都向小姐劝说：“据我们看来，不如就此卖掉，迁居到不似这般可怕的宅子里。

en.t: When the waiting women heard of this, they all urged the young lady, saying, "In our view, it would be better to sell it now and move to a house that is not so frightening as this one.

units.source_text: 长此下去，我们这些留下来伺候您的人也难于忍受了。”

en.t: If things go on like this, even those of us who remain here to serve you will hardly be able to endure it."

units.source_text: 末摘花流泪答道：“哎呀，你们这话好忍心呵！

en.t: Safflower answered through her tears, "Oh, how hard-hearted of you to say such a thing!

units.source_text: 出卖祖居，教人听见了岂不笑话？

en.t: If people heard that I had sold my ancestral home, would they not laugh at me?

units.source_text: 在我生存期间，怎么可做这离根忘本的行径呢？

en.t: While I am still alive, how could I do something so rootless and unfilial?

units.source_text: 这宅子虽然荒凉可怕，但想起了此乃父母面影长留的旧居，亦可慰我孤苦之情。”

en.t: Though this house is desolate and frightening, when I think that it is the old home where the images of my parents still linger, it can still comfort my lonely heart."
Without giving the matter further thought, she firmly refused.
